hyperedges.label: Data honesty rules across the project

nodes.label: Layered architecture (src/domain, src/services, src/ui, src/state)
nodes.rationale: Pure tested logic stays apart from replaceable providers, so a service can change without touching the screens.

nodes.label: Daily load model and rhythm strip (Fase 3)
nodes.norm_label: daily load model and rhythm strip (fase 3)

nodes.label: Nominatim fallback for lodging search (A-21)
nodes.rationale: Overpass returned 502 without CORS and its mirrors timed out; Nominatim serves the same OSM data at 1 request per second.

nodes.label: Realistic duration separate from theoretical (A-03)
nodes.rationale: Driving breaks and ferry waits were in no total, so days looked lighter than they were. The assumptions are editable and declared as assumptions.

nodes.label: Cloud stores a single JSON document, no version history (A-22)
nodes.norm_label: cloud stores a single json document, no version history (a-22)

nodes.label: Stable day key tappa#notte (A-01)
nodes.rationale: Activities tied to the day number moved to another place, with their cost, when a stop was reordered.

nodes.label: Coastal navigation with Hurtigruten and Havila
nodes.norm_label: coastal navigation with hurtigruten and havila

nodes.label: Distinct data entities (trips, stops, days, legs, lodging, sources)
nodes.norm_label: distinct data entities (trips, stops, days, legs, lodging, sources)

nodes.label: Transfer modes and map legs requirements
nodes.norm_label: transfer modes and map legs requirements

nodes.label: budgetOverlaps double-count warnings
nodes.rationale: The model has no field for marking that a manual cost includes a segment, so overlaps are only flagged and no amount is corrected.

nodes.label: Cruise catalog (src/data/coastalCatalog.ts)
nodes.rationale: Hurtigruten summer 2027 was not on sale, so no summer price is derived from its published values and the price stays 'da verificare'.

nodes.label: Autosave with conditional update on updated_at
nodes.norm_label: autosave with conditional update on updated_at

nodes.label: Trip configurator section
nodes.rationale: It always creates a new active scenario and keeps the previous one, so a proposal never overwrites the user's work.

nodes.label: Automatic EUR/NOK rate (Norges Bank, ECB via Frankfurter)
nodes.norm_label: automatic eur/nok rate (norges bank, ecb via frankfurter)

nodes.label: Flight search links without price API (src/services/flights/links.ts)
nodes.norm_label: flight search links without price api (src/services/flights/links.ts)
nodes.rationale: Amadeus Self-Service closed on 17/07/2026 and Kiwi Tequila is invite-only; Duffel or SerpApi would need a server function holding a secret key.

nodes.label: Fuel price from Statistics Norway table 09654
nodes.norm_label: fuel price from statistics norway table 09654

nodes.label: Hash routing instead of React Router
nodes.norm_label: hash routing instead of react router

nodes.label: comparability (src/domain/scenarios.ts)
nodes.rationale: A 'best' mark appears only on comparable rows: km and times need every leg calculated, costs need non-partial totals.

nodes.label: Multi-device conflict choice, no silent overwrite
nodes.norm_label: multi-device conflict choice, no silent overwrite

nodes.label: Esri World Topo fallback for file-opened HTML
nodes.norm_label: esri world topo fallback for file-opened html
nodes.rationale: OSM and CARTO block tile requests without a Referer, which is what happens when the HTML file is opened by double click.

nodes.label: Data status distinction (confermato, stimato, da verificare, prenotato, pagato)
nodes.norm_label: data status distinction (confermato, stimato, da verificare, prenotato, pagato)
nodes.rationale: Real decisions must not rest on data that only looks complete, so every value declares how reliable it is.

nodes.label: Ferries as separate segments (wait, schedule, cost)
nodes.norm_label: ferries as separate segments (wait, schedule, cost)

nodes.label: No bookings, no production changes without authorization, no secrets in repo
nodes.norm_label: no bookings, no production changes without authorization, no secrets in repo

nodes.label: No straight-line distance as road distance
nodes.norm_label: no straight-line distance as road distance

nodes.label: Guiding principle: a tool for real decisions, not a demo
nodes.norm_label: guiding principle: a tool for real decisions, not a demo

nodes.label: User stays in control: the app suggests, never changes silently
nodes.norm_label: user stays in control: the app suggests, never changes silently
